item.title: Circuit-level PDP-11/34 emulator
item.description:
📝 Kernel/user address spaces, 18-bit relocation (3x 74S283 adders), 16 PAR/PDR pairs, SR0/SR2 abort registers with freeze logic. Keeps simulated time in sync with wall-clock time. Sample Programs ll-34 comes with a few programs and systems to try: a Game of Life, V6 UNIX, RT-11 V4 with the original Tetris game, and ATTN/11, a small trainable Transformer with self-attention.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/dbrll/ll-34
